semantics: unmasked top-k is SCORE-RANKED over causal-visible positions (position < compress_len), ties to the lower position, result position-sorted and offset-shifted, unfilled slots -1; NOT a contiguous latest-window/positional run

cases.name: block_max_and_newest_pinned
cases.description: unmasked score-ranked top-k; the highest scorers are positions 0, 2 and 4 rather than a contiguous tail, and a higher-index low scorer is excluded even though it sits inside the causal window

cases.name: block_max_tie_lower_index_wins
cases.description: unmasked score-ranked top-k where a three-way exact tie straddles the top-k boundary; the lower positions win the tie and the unfilled slot is -1

cases.name: unmasked_topk_exceeds_visible_pads_after
cases.description: unmasked score-ranked arm where topK exceeds the visible count; the trailing -1 slots come from causal-invisible positions, and the highest raw scores in the vector sit outside the causal window so a whole-vector score read is discriminated from a visible-only read

cases.name: topk_blocks_control
cases.description: topKBlocks=1 source-candidate control arm; the mask excludes position 2 so the score-ranked result differs from the positional run, keeping the vector non-vacuous

cases.name: single_visible_row_masked
cases.description: masked arm with exactly one visible row; the two invisible slots are -1, pinning the masked representation alongside the unmasked rows
